ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% low-intensity (black) to 25% high-intensity (white/mottled) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black pigmentation across the central peduncle attachment and inner lobes; dense white mottling and contiguous white geometric blobs concentrated on the distal lateral margins of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a pixel-calculated internal angle of approximately 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, jagged boundary with high-frequency serrations (5-15 pixel amplitude) along the entire trailing edge from the distal tips to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge sweep transitioning to a scalloped concave inward curve along the trailing boundary toward the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast yellowish-white pixel clusters (rosette-like formations) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned light-colored linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) traversing the black pigmentation on the inner region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular notches and small missing tissue segments along the trailing edge topography; yellowish calcified deposits at the lobe extremities.
